verses.original: וַיָּבֹ֤א דָוִד֙ נֹ֔בֶה אֶל־ אֲחִימֶ֖לֶךְ הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיֶּחֱרַ֨ד אֲחִימֶ֜לֶךְ לִקְרַ֣את דָּוִ֗ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ מַדּ֤וּעַ אַתָּה֙ לְבַדֶּ֔ךָ וְאִ֖ישׁ אֵ֥ין אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ḏā·wiḏ nō·ḇeh ’el- ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ hak·kō·hên way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ ’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ liq·raṯ dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer lōw mad·dū·a‘ ’at·tāh lə·ḇad·de·ḵā wə·’îš ’ên ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest And when Ahimelech met David he trembled and asked him Why are you alone Why is no one with you
verses.literalPt: ENTÃO veio Davi a Nobe, ao sacerdote Aimeleque; e Aimeleque, tremendo, saiu ao encontro de Davi, e disse-lhe: Por que vens só, e ninguém contigo?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜ד לַאֲחִימֶ֣לֶךְ הַכֹּהֵ֗ן הַמֶּלֶךְ֮ צִוַּ֣נִי דָבָר֒ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י אִ֣ישׁ אַל־ יֵ֧דַע מְא֛וּמָה אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ אָנֹכִ֥י שֹׁלֵֽחֲךָ֖ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑ךָ וְאֶת־ הַנְּעָרִ֣ים יוֹדַ֔עְתִּי אֶל־ מְק֥וֹם פְּלֹנִ֖י אַלְמוֹנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ la·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ hak·kō·hên ham·me·leḵ ṣiw·wa·nî ḏā·ḇār way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ’îš ’al- yê·ḏa‘ mə·’ū·māh ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- ’ā·nō·ḵî šō·lê·ḥă·ḵā wa·’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯi·ḵā wə·’eṯ- han·nə·‘ā·rîm yō·w·ḏa‘·tî ’el- mə·qō·wm pə·lō·nî ’al·mō·w·nî
verses.literal: The king has given me a mission David replied - He told me no one is to know about the mission on which I am sending you . . . . . . And I have directed my young men to meet me at a certain place . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: E disse Davi ao sacerdote Aimeleque: O rei me encomendou um negócio, e me disse: Ninguém saiba deste negócio, pelo qual eu te enviei, e o qual te ordenei; quanto aos moços, apontei-lhes tal e tal lugar.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה מַה־ יֵּ֧שׁ תַּֽחַת־ יָדְךָ֛ חֲמִשָּׁה־ לֶ֖חֶם תְּנָ֣ה בְיָדִ֑י א֖וֹ הַנִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh mah- yêš ta·ḥaṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ḥă·miš·šāh- le·ḥem tə·nāh ḇə·yā·ḏî ’ōw han·nim·ṣā
verses.literal: Now then what do you have on hand Give me . . . five loaves of bread or whatever can be found
verses.literalPt: Agora, pois, que tens à mão? Dá-me cinco pães na minha mão, ou o que se achar.

verses.original: וַיַּ֨עַן הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֶת־ דָּוִד֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר אֵֽין־ לֶ֥חֶם חֹ֖ל אֶל־ תַּ֣חַת יָדִ֑י כִּֽי־ אִם־ לֶ֤חֶם קֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ יֵ֔שׁ אִם־ נִשְׁמְר֥וּ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים אַ֥ךְ מֵאִשָּֽׁה׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer ’ên- le·ḥem ḥōl ’el- ta·ḥaṯ yā·ḏî kî- ’im- le·ḥem qō·ḏeš yêš ’im- niš·mə·rū han·nə·‘ā·rîm ’aḵ mê·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: There is no common bread on hand the priest replied - but there is some consecrated bread provided that the young men have kept themselves from women
verses.literalPt: E, respondendo o sacerdote a Davi, disse: Não tenho pão comum à mão; há, porém, pão sagrado, se ao menos os moços se abstiveram das mulheres.

verses.original: וַיַּעַן֩ דָּוִ֨ד אֶת־ הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כִּ֣י אִם־ אִשָּׁ֤ה עֲצֻֽרָה־ לָ֙נוּ֙ כִּתְמ֣וֹל שִׁלְשֹׁ֔ם בְּצֵאתִ֕י וַיִּהְי֥וּ כְלֵֽי־ הַנְּעָרִ֖ים קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְהוּא֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ חֹ֔ל וְאַ֕ף כִּ֥י הַיּ֖וֹם יִקְדַּ֥שׁ בַּכֶּֽלִי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- hak·kō·hên way·yō·mer lōw kî ’im- ’iš·šāh ‘ă·ṣu·rāh- lā·nū kiṯ·mō·wl šil·šōm bə·ṣê·ṯî way·yih·yū ḵə·lê- han·nə·‘ā·rîm qō·ḏeš wə·hū de·reḵ ḥōl wə·’ap̄ kî hay·yō·wm yiq·daš bak·ke·lî
verses.literal: David answered - - Women have indeed been kept from us as is usual when I set out And the bodies of the young men are holy even on common missions How much more so . . . . . . today
verses.literalPt: E respondeu Davi ao sacerdote, e lhe disse: As mulheres, na verdade, se nos vedaram desde ontem e anteontem; quando eu saí, os vasos dos moços eram santos; e de algum modo é pão comum, sendo que hoje santifica-se outro no vaso.

verses.original: וַיִּתֶּן־ ל֥וֹ הַכֹּהֵ֖ן קֹ֑דֶשׁ כִּי֩ לֹא־ הָ֨יָה שָׁ֜ם לֶ֗חֶם כִּֽי־ אִם־ לֶ֤חֶם הַפָּנִים֙ הַמּֽוּסָרִים֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לָשׂוּם֙ לֶ֣חֶם חֹ֔ם בְּי֖וֹם הִלָּקְחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·ten- lōw hak·kō·hên qō·ḏeš kî lō- hā·yāh šām le·ḥem kî- ’im- le·ḥem hap·pā·nîm ham·mū·sā·rîm mil·lip̄·nê Yah·weh lā·śūm le·ḥem ḥōm bə·yō·wm hil·lā·qə·ḥōw
verses.literal: So the priest gave him the consecrated bread since there was no bread there but the Bread of the Presence which had been removed from before the LORD and replaced with hot bread on the day it was taken away
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote lhe deu o pão sagrado, porquanto não havia ali outro pão senão os pães da proposição, que se tiraram de diante do SENHOR, para se pôr ali pão quente no dia em que aquele se tirasse.

verses.original: וְשָׁ֡ם אִישׁ֩ מֵעַבְדֵ֨י שָׁא֜וּל בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא נֶעְצָר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּשְׁמ֖וֹ דֹּאֵ֣ג הָאֲדֹמִ֑י אַבִּ֥יר הָרֹעִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְשָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šām ’îš mê·‘aḇ·ḏê šā·’ūl bay·yō·wm ha·hū ne‘·ṣār lip̄·nê Yah·weh ū·šə·mōw dō·’êḡ hā·’ă·ḏō·mî ’ab·bîr hā·rō·‘îm ’ă·šer lə·šā·’ūl
verses.literal: Now one of Saul’s servants was there that day detained before the LORD And his name was Doeg the Edomite the chief shepherd for Saul
verses.literalPt: Estava, porém, ali naquele dia um dos criados de Saul, detido perante o SENHOR, e era seu nome Doegue, edomeu, o mais poderoso dos pastores de Saul.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לַאֲחִימֶ֔לֶךְ וְאִ֛ין יֶשׁ־ פֹּ֥ה תַֽחַת־ יָדְךָ֖ חֲנִ֣ית אוֹ־ חָ֑רֶב כִּ֣י גַם־ חַרְבִּ֤י וְגַם־ כֵּלַי֙ לֹֽא־ לָקַ֣חְתִּי בְיָדִ֔י כִּֽי־ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ נָחֽוּץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ la·’ă·ḥî·me·leḵ wə·’în yeš- pōh ṯa·ḥaṯ- yā·ḏə·ḵā ḥă·nîṯ ’ōw- ḥā·reḇ kî ḡam- ḥar·bî wə·ḡam- kê·lay lō- lā·qaḥ·tî ḇə·yā·ḏî kî- hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- ham·me·leḵ nā·ḥūṣ
verses.literal: Then David asked Ahimelech Is there not a spear or sword on hand here For I have brought neither my sword nor my weapons with me because the king’s mission was urgent
verses.literalPt: E disse Davi a Aimeleque: Não tens aqui à mão lança ou espada alguma? Porque não trouxe à mão nem a minha espada nem as minhas armas, porque o negócio do rei era apressado.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר הַכֹּהֵ֗ן חֶרֶב֩ גָּלְיָ֨ת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֜י אֲשֶׁר־ הִכִּ֣יתָ׀ בְּעֵ֣מֶק הָאֵלָ֗ה הִנֵּה־ הִ֞יא לוּטָ֣ה בַשִּׂמְלָה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י הָאֵפוֹד֒ אִם־ אֹתָ֤הּ תִּֽקַּח־ לְךָ֙ קָ֔ח כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין אַחֶ֛רֶת זוּלָתָ֖הּ בָּזֶ֑ה וַיֹּ֧אמֶר דָּוִ֛ד אֵ֥ין כָּמ֖וֹהָ תְּנֶ֥נָּה לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hak·kō·hên ḥe·reḇ gā·lə·yāṯ hap·pə·liš·tî ’ă·šer- hik·kî·ṯā bə·‘ê·meq hā·’ê·lāh hin·nêh- hî lū·ṭāh ḇaś·śim·lāh ’a·ḥă·rê hā·’ê·p̄ō·wḏ ’im- ’ō·ṯāh tiq·qaḥ- lə·ḵā qāḥ kî ’ên ’a·ḥe·reṯ zū·lā·ṯāh bā·zeh way·yō·mer dā·wiḏ ’ên kā·mō·w·hā tə·nen·nāh lî
verses.literal: The priest replied The sword of Goliath the Philistine whom you killed in the Valley of Elah is here it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod If you want you may take it . . . . . . For there is no other but this one here And David said There is none like it give it to me
verses.literalPt: E disse o sacerdote: A espada de Golias, o filisteu, a quem tu feriste no vale do carvalho, eis que está aqui envolta num pano detrás do éfode. Se tu a queres tomar, toma-a, porque nenhuma outra há aqui, senão aquela. E disse Davi: Não há outra semelhante; dá-ma.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּבְרַ֥ח בַּיּוֹם־ הַה֖וּא מִפְּנֵ֣י שָׁא֑וּל וַיָּבֹ֕א אֶל־ אָכִ֖ישׁ מֶ֥לֶךְ גַּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām dā·wiḏ way·yiḇ·raḥ bay·yō·wm- ha·hū mip·pə·nê šā·’ūl way·yā·ḇō ’el- ’ā·ḵîš me·leḵ gaṯ
verses.literal: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath
verses.literalPt: E Davi levantou-se, e fugiu aquele dia de diante de Saul, e foi a Aquis, rei de Gate.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ עַבְדֵ֤י אָכִישׁ֙ אֵלָ֔יו הֲלוֹא־ זֶ֥ה דָוִ֖ד מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאָ֑רֶץ הֲל֣וֹא לָזֶ֗ה יַעֲנ֤וּ בַמְּחֹלוֹת֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ בְּאַלְפּוֹ וְדָוִ֖ד בְּרִבְבֹתוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ‘aḇ·ḏê ’ā·ḵîš ’ê·lāw hă·lō·w- zeh ḏā·wiḏ me·leḵ hā·’ā·reṣ hă·lō·w lā·zeh ya·‘ă·nū ḇam·mə·ḥō·lō·wṯ lê·mōr hik·kāh šā·’ūl bə·ʾal·pō wə·ḏā·wiḏ bə·ri·ḇə·ḇō·ṯō
verses.literal: But the servants of Achish said to him Is this not David the king of the land Did they not sing about him in their dances saying Saul has slain his thousands and David his tens of thousands
verses.literalPt: Porém os criados de Aquis lhe disseram: Não é este Davi, o rei da terra? Não se cantava deste nas danças, dizendo: Saul feriu os seus milhares, porém Davi os seus dez milhares?

verses.original: וַיָּ֧שֶׂם דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֥ים הָאֵ֖לֶּה בִּלְבָב֑וֹ וַיִּרָ֣א מְאֹ֔ד מִפְּנֵ֖י אָכִ֥ישׁ מֶֽלֶךְ־ גַּֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śem dā·wiḏ ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh bil·ḇā·ḇōw way·yi·rā mə·’ōḏ mip·pə·nê ’ā·ḵîš me·leḵ- gaṯ
verses.literal: Now David took these words to heart and was very much afraid of Achish the king of Gath
verses.literalPt: E Davi considerou estas palavras no seu ânimo, e temeu muito diante de Aquis, rei de Gate.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁנּ֤וֹ אֶת־ טַעְמוֹ֙ בְּעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּתְהֹלֵ֖ל בְּיָדָ֑ם וַיְתַו עַל־ דַּלְת֣וֹת הַשַּׁ֔עַר וַיּ֥וֹרֶד רִיר֖וֹ אֶל־ זְקָנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·šan·nōw ’eṯ- ṭa‘·mōw bə·‘ê·nê·hem way·yiṯ·hō·lêl bə·yā·ḏām way·ṯaw ‘al- dal·ṯō·wṯ haš·ša·‘ar way·yō·w·reḏ rî·rōw ’el- zə·qā·nōw
verses.literal: So he changed his behavior before them and feigned madness in their hands he scratched on the doors of the gate and let his saliva run down his beard
verses.literalPt: Por isso se contrafez diante dos olhos deles, e fez-se como doido entre as suas mãos, e esgravatava nas portas de entrada, e deixava correr a saliva pela barba.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אָכִ֖ישׁ אֶל־ עֲבָדָ֑יו הִנֵּ֤ה תִרְאוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִשְׁתַּגֵּ֔עַ לָ֛מָּה תָּבִ֥יאוּ אֹת֖וֹ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ā·ḵîš ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw hin·nêh ṯir·’ū ’îš miš·tag·gê·a‘ lām·māh tā·ḇî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: Then Achish said to his servants Look you can see that the man is insane Why have you brought him to me
verses.literalPt: Então disse Aquis aos seus criados: Eis que bem vedes que este homem está louco; por que mo trouxestes a mim?

verses.original: חֲסַ֤ר מְשֻׁגָּעִים֙ אָ֔נִי כִּי־ הֲבֵאתֶ֣ם אֶת־ זֶ֔ה לְהִשְׁתַּגֵּ֖עַ עָלָ֑י הֲזֶ֖ה יָב֥וֹא אֶל־ בֵּיתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥă·sar mə·šug·gā·‘îm ’ā·nî kî- hă·ḇê·ṯem ’eṯ- zeh lə·hiš·tag·gê·a‘ ‘ā·lāy hă·zeh yā·ḇō·w ’el- bê·ṯî
verses.literal: Am I in need of madmen that you have brought this man to rave in my presence Must this man come into my house
verses.literalPt: Faltam-me a mim doidos, para que trouxésseis a este para que fizesse doidices diante de mim? Há de entrar este na minha casa?
